_readme: Pi message resolution cases for Go and TypeScript. Each native result keeps its original inline preview, images, and reported paths. Obsolete saved-text supplements cannot replace native results. A retained start frame can recover its last native partial result when the exact tool and call identities match. The corpus preserves malformed and absent fields also.
